definitions.gloss: mechanical pencil; propelling pencil (with refillable leads)
definitions.explanation: A pencil with a thin lead that can be extended or retracted using a mechanism, typically by clicking the end. Refill leads are replaceable. In casual speech, almost always shortened to シャーペン. The full form シャープペンシル sounds slightly formal or old-fashioned.

examples.japanese: シャープペンシル⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write with a mechanical pencil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧シャープペンシル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new mechanical pencil.

examples.english: The lead of the mechanical pencil broke, so I replaced it with a new one.

notes:
A Japanese-made English (wasei-eigo) term — the word 'sharp pencil' is not used in English, where 'mechanical pencil' or 'propelling pencil' is standard. The name derives from an early Japanese brand 'Ever-Sharp' and became generic in Japanese.

USAGE:
In everyday conversation, almost always shortened to ⟦シャーペン→シャーペン：25678_shaapen⟧. The full シャープペンシル appears mainly in writing, on packaging, or in formal speech. Students and office workers use them constantly; most study notes and exams in Japan are written with them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シャープペンシル⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write with a mechanical pencil
- シャープペンシル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧: the lead of a mechanical pencil
- シャープペンシル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧: the lead breaks
- ⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to insert lead refills
- シャープペンシル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use a mechanical pencil

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦シャーペン→シャーペン：25678_shaapen⟧: everyday contraction — the usual spoken form
- ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧: (regular) pencil — wooden, sharpened by hand
- ⟦{芯|しん}→芯：03888_shin⟧: the lead (inside a mechanical pencil or pencil)
- ⟦ボールペン→ボールペン：00691_boorupen⟧: ballpoint pen
- ⟦{万年筆|まんねんひつ}→万年筆：02968_mannenhitsu⟧: fountain pen

REGISTER:
Neutral; the full form is slightly more formal than ⟦シャーペン→シャーペン：25678_shaapen⟧. Both are standard. Schools and publishers typically use the full form in official documents.
